claims.claim: A magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck Gaziantep Province, Turkey, killing at least 3,400 people.
A second magnitude 7.5 earthquake occurred in Kahramanmaraş, Turkey, nine hours after the first.

On the flagged day, a prison riot broke out in Hatay Province, Turkey, with inmates demanding to see earthquake-affected families, resulting in three deaths and twelve injuries after soldiers opened fire.

A separate, unrelated geopolitical event on Day 9 involved the U.S. closing airspace off the East Coast and shooting down a high-altitude balloon, indicating heightened US-related tension in the window.
